Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink…

translations.web: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
